description:
Reid Urban C1 WSD | Women's Commuter City Bike

Comfortable, practical and designed for everyday journeys – the Reid Bikes Urban C1 WSD is a versatile women's commuter bike built for comfortable city riding, efficient commuting and longer weekend rides.

The Reid Bikes Urban C1 WSD bike combines stylish design with reliable performance, making it an ideal choice for women looking for a comfortable, practical and eco-friendly way to get around. Its women's-specific design offers a considered fit for everyday riding, while its sleek paint finish adds a stylish touch to your daily commute.

Responsive handling and a comfortable riding position make navigating busy streets and cycle paths easy. Kenda 42c tyres provide a smooth, stable ride across a range of urban surfaces, while the Reid city comfort saddle offers extra support for daily journeys and longer rides.

A Shimano 16-speed drivetrain gives you plenty of gearing options for flat roads, hills and longer commutes, helping you tackle varied terrain with confidence. Tektro hydraulic disc brakes deliver reliable, controlled stopping power in changing conditions, while double-wall rims add durability for everyday use.

Designed to make cycling a more convenient alternative to driving, the Reid Bikes Urban C1 WSD bike helps you avoid traffic and parking hassles while incorporating more activity into your daily routine. Whether you're commuting to work, running errands around town or heading out for a weekend ride, this women's hybrid-style city bike offers a practical balance of comfort, versatility and performance.

With its comfortable setup, dependable components and urban-ready design, the Reid Urban C1 WSD bike makes everyday cycling an enjoyable way to travel more actively and sustainably.

The Reid Bikes Urban C1 WSD is ideal for:

Everyday commuters looking for a comfortable, efficient women's commuter bike for travelling to work and getting around town

City and urban riding, with responsive handling and a smooth, stable ride on streets and cycle paths

Women seeking a comfortable riding experience, with a women's-specific design and Reid city comfort saddle

Riders tackling varied terrain, with Shimano 16-speed gearing for hills, flat roads and longer commutes

Comfort-focused cyclists, with Kenda 42c tyres designed to provide a stable, comfortable ride across a range of surfaces

Riders who want reliable braking performance, with Tektro hydraulic disc brakes for confident stopping in changing conditions

Regular commuters and weekend cyclists, thanks to double-wall rims and a versatile setup suited to everyday use

Anyone looking for an eco-friendly alternative to driving, helping reduce reliance on the car while making everyday journeys more active and enjoyable
